messages:
nina: FYI onboarding melusine-13b-int4 hit reproducible OOMs under mixed contexts. happens ~90-120s into canary at ~35 qps.

pax: reproduction command?

nina: `./canary --model melusine-13b-int4 --qps 35 --concurrency 12 --max_new_tokens 256 --batching windowed`

remi: logs show allocator fragmentation: `largest_contig=5.8GiB total_free=17.2GiB small_chunks=44` — allocator can’t carve contiguous KV slabs.

pax: quick mitigations: lower default max_new_tokens to 128, set slot_compactor=true, kv_prefetch=false. any quality impact?

qa-bot: quick sweep (500 summarization prompts): float16 ROUGE-L=35.1, int4=33.2, int8=34.9. int4 quality drop ~1.9.

nina: int4 lowers cost/latency but quality regressed and frag risk. I tested `kv_prefetch=false` + compactor and OOMs stopped, p99 latency +10%.

remi: plan: 1) ship safe defaults to canary (max_new_tokens=128, slot_compactor on, kv_prefetch off); 2) add routing fallback to int8 on OOM spike; 3) run quant experiments (outlier-aware per-channel, try 5-bit) before enabling int4 in prod.

pax: opened PR #4678 with defaults and canary gating, and filed INF-2738 for allocator tuning.

nina: noted. will run extended QA sweep overnight. thanks all. :thumbsup:
